### Important safety information

### Lingo

* * * *

The Lingo Glucose System is intended for users 18 years and older not on insulin. It is NOT intended
for diagnosis of diseases, including diabetes.

The Lingo program does not guarantee that everyone will achieve the same results as individual
responses may vary. Consult your healthcare professional before making changes to your diet or
exercise regime or if you have an eating disorder or a history of eating disorders.

The product images are representative only.

## We make it possible.

# You make it matter.

Haemonetics provides a suite of innovative medical technology solutions that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We challenge ourselves to think big and make new possibilities
a reality, so that our customers can make it matter for patients, every single day

[Haemonetics]
[Hospitals]

## Advancing Patient Care at Hospitals

We provide hospitals with quality solutions designed to enhance clinical outcomes, improve
procedural effectiveness and advance healthcare standards.

[Learn More][78]
[Plasma BU website]

## Optimizing Operations for Plasma Centers

We offer innovative technologies that enable higher plasma yield collections, help improve
productivity and quality in our customers’ centers, and enhance the overall donor experience.

[Learn More][79]
[Blood]

## Driving Efficiency for Blood Centers

We advance products and services to help ensure blood safety, improve operational efficiency and
collect the blood components in the greatest demand.

[Learn More][80]
[join our team]

CAREERS

## Join Our Winning Team

At Haemonetics, the work you do matters. Join us in advancing healthcare while you advance your own
career and make your ideas, commitment and passion matter every day.

[Learn how you can make it matter][81]
[making a difference]

OUR MISSION

## Making Our Work Matter

We develop innovative medical technology products and services that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We are building a collaborative, performance-driven culture
that attracts and develops the best talent.

[See what drives us][82]
[guided by purpose]

CORPORATE RESPONSIBILITY

## Guided by Purpose

At Haemonetics, our Purpose inspires the important work we do every day to meaningfully advance
patient care and drive greater possibilities in healthcare. How we do this work is equally
important. We are guided by our Purpose, and mindful of our shareholders, customers, employees and
other key stakeholders whose trust we value. We are committed to being a good corporate citizen and
take responsibility to proactively identify and manage the environmental, social and governance
risks and opportunities that are relevant to our business and those we serve.

[Learn More][83]

## We make it possible.

# You make it matter.

Haemonetics provides a suite of innovative medical technology solutions that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We challenge ourselves to think big and make new possibilities
a reality, so that our customers can make it matter for patients, every single day

[Haemonetics]
[Hospitals]

## Advancing Patient Care at Hospitals

We provide hospitals with quality solutions designed to enhance clinical outcomes, improve
procedural effectiveness and advance healthcare standards.

[Learn More][78]
[Plasma BU website]

## Optimizing Operations for Plasma Centers

We offer innovative technologies that enable higher plasma yield collections, help improve
productivity and quality in our customers’ centers, and enhance the overall donor experience.

[Learn More][79]
[Blood]

## Driving Efficiency for Blood Centers

We advance products and services to help ensure blood safety, improve operational efficiency and
collect the blood components in the greatest demand.

[Learn More][80]
[join our team]

CAREERS

## Join Our Winning Team

At Haemonetics, the work you do matters. Join us in advancing healthcare while you advance your own
career and make your ideas, commitment and passion matter every day.

[Learn how you can make it matter][81]
[making a difference]

OUR MISSION

## Making Our Work Matter

We develop innovative medical technology products and services that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We are building a collaborative, performance-driven culture
that attracts and develops the best talent.

[See what drives us][82]
[guided by purpose]

CORPORATE RESPONSIBILITY

## Guided by Purpose

At Haemonetics, our Purpose inspires the important work we do every day to meaningfully advance
patient care and drive greater possibilities in healthcare. How we do this work is equally
important. We are guided by our Purpose, and mindful of our shareholders, customers, employees and
other key stakeholders whose trust we value. We are committed to being a good corporate citizen and
take responsibility to proactively identify and manage the environmental, social and governance
risks and opportunities that are relevant to our business and those we serve.

## Our Services


Acumen Group is a specialised water consulting company with expertise focused on water and
wastewater solutions. What differentiates us is our attention to detail and our team of highly
skilled professionals. We provide comprehensive support across the entire project lifecycle - from
understanding our clients’ needs, through design and implementation, to commissioning, maintenance,
and ongoing after-sales support.


[Download Company Profile][41]

## Acumen Group Divisions
* ### Chemicals
  
  Where innovation and quality converge to meet the diverse needs of various industries. We offer a
  comprehensive range of high-performance chemicals designed to enhance processes, improve
  efficiency, and ensure safety across multiple applications, including water treatment, industrial
  manufacturing, and environmental management
  
  [Discover More  ][42]
* ### Plants
  
  Where innovation and expertise ensure the delivery of safe, clean, and reliable water. Our
  state-of-the-art water treatment plants are designed to meet the diverse needs of municipal,
  industrial, and commercial clients, transforming raw water into potable or process water that
  meets the highest quality standards
  
  [Discover More  ][43]
* ### Process
  
  Where precision and innovation drive operational excellence. We specialize in providing
  comprehensive process solutions tailored to enhance efficiency, productivity, and quality across
  various industries, including manufacturing, chemical processing, and water treatment.
  
  [Discover More  ][44]

## Acumen Group Solutions

### Chemicals: Coagulants

Coagulants play a crucial role in the removal of suspended solids, turbidity, and other contaminants
from water, ensuring clarity and safety. Our range of high-performance coagulants is designed to

#### Your Solution: Anesthesia Experts!

We can tackle these issues together. Our satisfied clients can attest to the positive changes
Anesthesia Experts provides. To learn how we can streamline your anesthesia department, just call
[660-596-2224][18] or [click here to email us][19]. Elevate your anesthesia services with us today!

with clearer monthly reporting and better transparency."

Igloo Reader Pro analyzes rapid diagnostic tests using digital quantitative technology. The device
eliminates subjective visual interpretation and delivers consistent, standardized results within
minutes.

innovative and trusted solutions to screen, diagnose, and treat disorders affecting the brain and
neural pathways.

We are dedicated to providing unparalleled service to ensure a seamless experience, helping our
partners to deliver the highest standard of care and achieve the best possible patient outcomes.

possible results. Natus Academies provide expert knowledge, clinical expertise and advanced
education – whatever your role, wherever you work.

  ## [Fixing Medicare’s Part B HIT Services Benefit][54]
  
  While Congress intended to create a comprehensive Medicare home infusion benefit for Part B DME
  drugs in the 21st Century Cures Act, flawed implementation by CMS has led to limited access for
  Medicare beneficiaries. The Preserving Patient Access to Home Infusion Act would restore
  congressional intent and promote access to home-based care by mirroring the successful model
  employed by nearly every U.S. commercial plan.

* 01.
  [Lyophilized Reagents][68]
  
  Revolutionizing Diagnostics Logistics: The Poclight C5000 with Lyophilized Reagents The Poclight
  C5000 Chemiluminescence Immunoassay Analyzer is engineered with a dry system utilizing lyophilized
  (freeze-dried) reagents, completely eliminating the need for cold chain transportation. This
  innovation dramatically reduces shipping costs, simplifies global logistics, and enhances reagent
  stability during long-distance and high-temperature conditions. Unlike traditional systems
  requiring temperature-controlled transport, the C5000’s lyophilized reagents allow for

# PolyPublie - Polytechnique Montréal's Institutional Repository

PolyPublie is the institutional repository of Polytechnique Montréal. Its main purpose is to collect

# Surgicalcriticalcare.net

][11]

Surgicalcriticalcare.net is an online, interactive, educational resource based at the Surgical
Critical Care Fellowship program at Orlando Regional Medical Center. It is open to any physician,
nurse, respiratory therapist, medical student, or other allied healthcare provider interested in the
discipline of Surgical Critical Care or Acute Care Surgery. SurgicalCriticalCare.net is designed to
provide rapid access to essential information for caring for patients with critical illness.

### What's New?
* **A new checklist has been developed to guide the [initial resuscitation of the burn
  victim][12].**
* **Open fractures are at higher risk for polymicrobial infection, especially if contaminated with
  soil or water. A new guideline has been developed to guide the appropriate antibiotic coverage of
  such injuries. See the [Open Fracture Prophylaxis][13] guideline.**
* **Paroxysmal Sympathetic Hyperactivity (PSH) or "neurostorming" is common following traumatic
  brain injury. A new guideline has been developed to guide the management of PSH. See the
  [Paroxysmal Sympathetic Hyperactivity][14] guideline.**
* **A new guideline has been developed on the management of Corneal Burn Injury. See the [Corneal
  Burn Injury][15] guideline.**
* **A new guideline has been developed on the management of Chemical Burns. See the [Chemical
  Burns][16] guideline.**
* **Stevens-Johnson Syndrome / Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis is a potentially devastating desquamating
  skin disease commonly referred to burn centers. See the [Stevens-Johnson Syndrome / Toxic
  Epidermal Necrolysis ][17] guideline.**
* **The "Syncope Workup in Trauma Patients" guideline as been revised. See [Syncope Workup in Trauma
  Patients][18].**
* **The "Premature Gastrostomy/Jejunostomy Tube Removal" guideline as been revised. See [Premature
  Gastrostomy/Jejunostomy Removal][19].**
* **The "Stress Ulcer Prophylaxis" guideline as been revised. See [Stress Ulcer Prophylaxis][20].**

[

****Our Evidence Based Medicine guidelines are used in intensive care units and hospitals around the
world. New and revised guidelines are released each month.

# Home

## Bexyhub Lab

### **Welcome to Bexyhub Lab, your trusted source for clinical data**

[**Lab Science**][17]
[**Autoimmune**][18]
[**Infection- PCR**][19]
[**Genetic- Exome**][20]
[**CSF – Routine**][21]

#### Precision Clinical Insights & Diagnostic Excellence

[Deepak Kumar, an MSc Nursing Officer with 3 years of ICU experience, presenting clinical lab
insights on Bexyhub Lab.]

**Deepak-Kumar-MSc-Nursing-Officer-Bexyhub-Lab**


**बेक्सीहब लैब – सटीक क्लिनिकल अंतर्दृष्टि और उत्कृष्ट नैदानिक समाधान**

## 
## Bridging the Gap Between Medical Theory and ICU Reality


**मेडिकल थ्योरी और आईसीयू की असलियत के बीच के अंतर को कम करना**

[**Laboratory Hub**][22]
[**Laboratory Science**][23]


The Man Who Discovered the World’s First Antibiotic: Penicillin


“नर्सिंग ऑफिसर के रूप में हमें यह याद रखना चाहिए कि एंटीबायोटिक रेजिस्टेंस (Antibiotic Resistance) आज सबसे बड़ा
खतरा है। फ्लेमिंग ने खोज के समय ही चेतावनी दी थी कि अगर दवा का गलत इस्तेमाल हुआ, तो भविष्य में बैक्टीरिया इसे बेअसर
कर देंगे।”


अलेक्जेंडर फ्लेमिंग के उन 7 चमत्कारी प्रयोगों के बारे में जानने के लिए, जिन्होंने पूरी मेडिकल साइंस को बदल कर रख दिया, नीचे
देखें

**👇**

[Sir Alexander Fleming Portrait - Discoverer of Penicillin Antibiotic - Bexyhub Lab]

Nature makes penicillin; I only found it.”
प्रकृति पेनिसिलिन बनाती है; मैंने तो बस इसे खोजा है।”

## 
## Expert Lab Knowledge by a Professional Nursing Officer

**Never give Potassium (KCl) as a direct IV push it can stop the heart instantly.**


**पोटैशियम (KCl) को कभी भी सीधा IV इंजेक्शन न दें; यह दिल की धड़कन को तुरंत रोक सकता है।**

“The Man Who Saved Millions from Infection”
लुई पाश्चर के उन 7 आविष्कारों के बारे में जानने के लिए जो आज भी ICU और लैब में जान बचा रहे हैं, नीचे देखें

नर्सिंग ऑफिसर के रूप में हमें यह याद रखना चाहिए कि ‘Pasteurization’ और ‘Vaccination’ की नींव इसी चेहरे ने रखी
थी।”

👇

[Louis Pasteur 1857 Portrait - Father of Microbiology - Bexyhub Lab]

In the fields of observation, chance favors only the prepared mind.
अवलोकन के क्षेत्र में, भाग्य केवल उसी का साथ देता है जिसका मस्तिष्क पहले से तैयार हो।”

## 
## Check the patient’s blood sugar immediately if they become suddenly confused or sweaty.


**अगर मरीज अचानक घबराया हुआ या पसीने से तरबतर लगे, तो तुरंत शुगर चेक करें।**


**Always flush the IV line before and after giving Phenytoin to avoid medicine crystals.**


**फेनिटोइन (Phenytoin) देने से पहले और बाद में IV लाइन को फ्लश करें ताकि दवा जमे नहीं।**

[**Clinical Investigations**][24]
[**History Lab**][25]

## 
## An ABG sample must be taken in a heparinized syringe and tested within 15 minutes.


**ABG का सैंपल हमेशा हेपरिन वाली सिरिंज में लें और 15 मिनट के अंदर जांच करवाएं।**

## 
## **A high Lactate level in the blood is a hidden sign that the body is in shock.**


**खून में लैक्टेट का बढ़ा हुआ स्तर एक छिपा हुआ संकेत है कि शरीर ‘शॉक’ में है।**


Don’t rely only on the monitor; always check the patient’s actual pulse and breathing.


सिर्फ मॉनिटर के भरोसे न रहें; हमेशा मरीज की असली नब्ज और सांस की जांच करें।


Wait at least 30 minutes after nebulization before checking a patient’s SpO2 level.


मरीज को भाप (Nebulization) देने के कम से कम 30 मिनट बाद ही ऑक्सीजन (SpO2) चेक करें।

The Man Who Proved ‘One Germ, One Disease'”
रॉबर्ट कोच के “4 विशेष सिद्धांतों” (Koch’s Postulates) के बारे में जानने के लिए जो आज भी टीबी (TB) और हैजा
(Cholera) के निदान (Diagnosis) में मदद कर रहे हैं, नीचे देखें

नर्सिंग ऑफिसर के रूप में हमें यह याद रखना चाहिए कि ‘Acid-Fast Bacilli’ (AFB) स्टैंडिंग रॉबर्ट कोच की सबसे बड़ी देन
है।”

**👇**

[Robert Koch Portrait - Founder of Modern Bacteriology - Bexyhub Lab]

If a bacterium is the cause of a disease, it must be found in every case of the disease.”
यदि कोई जीवाणु किसी बीमारी का कारण है, तो उसे बीमारी के हर मामले में पाया जाना चाहिए।”


High Urea and Creatinine levels mean the kidneys are struggling to filter waste.


यूरिया और क्रिएटिनिन का बढ़ा होना मतलब है कि किडनी कचरा साफ करने में असमर्थ है।

[**Report Decoder**][26]
[**Explore New Lab**][27]

खतरा है। फ्लेमिंग ने खोज के समय ही चेतावनी दी थी कि अगर दवा का गलत इस्तेमाल हुआ, तो भविष्य में बैक्टीरिया इसे बेअसर
कर देंगे।”


अलेक्जेंडर फ्लेमिंग के उन 7 चमत्कारी प्रयोगों के बारे में जानने के लिए, जिन्होंने पूरी मेडिकल साइंस को बदल कर रख दिया, नीचे
देखें

Nature makes penicillin; I only found it.”
प्रकृति पेनिसिलिन बनाती है; मैंने तो बस इसे खोजा है।”

## 
## Expert Lab Knowledge by a Professional Nursing Officer

**Never give Potassium (KCl) as a direct IV push it can stop the heart instantly.**


**पोटैशियम (KCl) को कभी भी सीधा IV इंजेक्शन न दें; यह दिल की धड़कन को तुरंत रोक सकता है।**

“The Man Who Saved Millions from Infection”
लुई पाश्चर के उन 7 आविष्कारों के बारे में जानने के लिए जो आज भी ICU और लैब में जान बचा रहे हैं, नीचे देखें

नर्सिंग ऑफिसर के रूप में हमें यह याद रखना चाहिए कि ‘Pasteurization’ और ‘Vaccination’ की नींव इसी चेहरे ने रखी
थी।”

👇

[Louis Pasteur 1857 Portrait - Father of Microbiology - Bexyhub Lab]

In the fields of observation, chance favors only the prepared mind.
अवलोकन के क्षेत्र में, भाग्य केवल उसी का साथ देता है जिसका मस्तिष्क पहले से तैयार हो।”

## 
## Check the patient’s blood sugar immediately if they become suddenly confused or sweaty.


**अगर मरीज अचानक घबराया हुआ या पसीने से तरबतर लगे, तो तुरंत शुगर चेक करें।**


**Always flush the IV line before and after giving Phenytoin to avoid medicine crystals.**


**फेनिटोइन (Phenytoin) देने से पहले और बाद में IV लाइन को फ्लश करें ताकि दवा जमे नहीं।**

[**History Lab**][25]

## 
## An ABG sample must be taken in a heparinized syringe and tested within 15 minutes.


**ABG का सैंपल हमेशा हेपरिन वाली सिरिंज में लें और 15 मिनट के अंदर जांच करवाएं।**

## 
## **A high Lactate level in the blood is a hidden sign that the body is in shock.**


**खून में लैक्टेट का बढ़ा हुआ स्तर एक छिपा हुआ संकेत है कि शरीर ‘शॉक’ में है।**


Don’t rely only on the monitor; always check the patient’s actual pulse and breathing.


सिर्फ मॉनिटर के भरोसे न रहें; हमेशा मरीज की असली नब्ज और सांस की जांच करें।


Wait at least 30 minutes after nebulization before checking a patient’s SpO2 level.


मरीज को भाप (Nebulization) देने के कम से कम 30 मिनट बाद ही ऑक्सीजन (SpO2) चेक करें।

The Man Who Proved ‘One Germ, One Disease'”
रॉबर्ट कोच के “4 विशेष सिद्धांतों” (Koch’s Postulates) के बारे में जानने के लिए जो आज भी टीबी (TB) और हैजा
(Cholera) के निदान (Diagnosis) में मदद कर रहे हैं, नीचे देखें

नर्सिंग ऑफिसर के रूप में हमें यह याद रखना चाहिए कि ‘Acid-Fast Bacilli’ (AFB) स्टैंडिंग रॉबर्ट कोच की सबसे बड़ी देन
है।”

**👇**

[Robert Koch Portrait - Founder of Modern Bacteriology - Bexyhub Lab]

If a bacterium is the cause of a disease, it must be found in every case of the disease.”
यदि कोई जीवाणु किसी बीमारी का कारण है, तो उसे बीमारी के हर मामले में पाया जाना चाहिए।”


High Urea and Creatinine levels mean the kidneys are struggling to filter waste.


यूरिया और क्रिएटिनिन का बढ़ा होना मतलब है कि किडनी कचरा साफ करने में असमर्थ है।

Keep the head of the bed at 30-45 degrees to prevent pneumonia in ventilated patients.


वेंटिलेटर वाले मरीजों को निमोनिया से बचाने के लिए सिर को 30-45 डिग्री ऊपर रखें।


A sudden drop in urine output is the first warning sign of kidney failure.


पेशाब की मात्रा में अचानक कमी आना किडनी फेल होने का सबसे पहला इशारा है।

The Martyr of Science: The First Woman to Win a Nobel Prize

नर्सिंग ऑफिसर के रूप में हमें यह याद रखना चाहिए कि मैरी क्यूरी की खोजें आज कैंसर मरीजों के लिए ‘रेडियोथेरेपी’
(Radiotherapy) के रूप में जीवनदायिनी हैं। लेकिन, हमें रेडिएशन के खतरों (Alara Principle: As Low As Reasonably
Achievable) के प्रति भी जागरूक रहना चाहिए, क्योंकि मैरी क्यूरी ने विज्ञान के लिए अपनी जान रेडिएशन की वजह से ही
गवाई थी।”


मैडम मैरी क्यूरी के उस संघर्ष और रेडियम (Radium) की खोज के बारे में जानने के लिए, जिसने कैंसर के इलाज में एक नई क्रांति ला
दी, नीचे देखें

[Madam Marie Curie Portrait - Discoverer of Radioactivity & Radium - Bexyhub Lab]

Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more, so
that we may fear less.”
जीवन में कुछ भी डरने के लिए नहीं है, यह केवल समझने के लिए है। अब और अधिक समझने का समय है, ताकि हम कम डरें।”

## Easy-to-understand lab reports for students and common people.

हैं, तो हमें इस भारतीय महान वैज्ञानिक का योगदान हमेशा याद रखना चाहिए।”


डॉ. येल्लाप्रगड़ा सुब्बाराव के उन क्रांतिकारी लैब परीक्षणों के बारे में जानने के लिए, जिन्होंने पूरी दुनिया को ‘एटीपी’

TheNNT Rating System
**The Green Rating**
Therapies rated green are the best you can get
**The Yellow Rating**
Therapies rated yellow require more studies OR therapies with equal efficacy.
**The Red Rating**
Red suggest that benefits and harms may be equal or equivocal.
**The Black Rating**
Therapies rated black have very clear harms without any benefit.

## Highlighted Reviews

05/14/2026

### [Alpha-Lipoic Acid for Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy][43]

Alpha-lipoic acid shows little to no benefit over placebo for improving symptoms or impairment
[Read More][44]
04/30/2026

### [Testosterone Replacement in Men With Sexual Dysfunction in the Absence of Hypogonadism][45]

Testosterone replacement therapy shows no clear benefit over placebo
[Read More][46]
04/23/2026

### [Sustained-Release Naltrexone for Opioid Dependence][47]

Sustained-release naltrexone reduces illicit opioid use compared to standard care but shows slightly
worse outcomes than opioid agonists
[Read More][48]

## Recent Reviews

04/09/2026

### [Gonadotropins for Infertility in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome][49]

Gonadotropins increased live birth and clinical pregnancy rates
[Read More][50]
04/07/2026

### [Surgical vs. Nonsurgical Treatments for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome][51]

Surgery resulted in higher clinical improvement at long-term follow-up compared with splinting alone
[Read More][52]
03/31/2026

### [Higher Versus Lower Mean Arterial Blood Pressure Targets in Vasodilatory Shock][53]

Higher MAP targets are likely associated with increased 28-day all-cause mortality, less RRT-free
days, and increased risk of arrhythmia
[Read More][54]
02/17/2026

### [Extracorporeal Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation for Refractory Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest][55]

Extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation did not improve favorable neurological status at the
shortest follow-up and at 6 months or reduce in-hospital mortality when compared to conventional
ACLS
[Read More][56]
02/12/2026

### [Intravenous Thrombolysis for Minor Acute Ischemic Stroke][57]

Intravenous thrombolysis lowered functional independence and increased deaths at 90 days
[Read More][58]
01/29/2026

### [Noninvasive Respiratory Support for Pediatric Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure][59]

Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) reduced risk of invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV)
compared to standard oxygen therapy (SOT), while both CPAP and high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC)
reduced treatment failure compared to SOT
[Read More][60]

based on their patient-important benefits and harms as well as a system to evaluate diagnostics by
patient sign, symptom, lab test or study.

We only use the highest quality, evidence-based studies (frequently, but not always Cochrane
Reviews), and we accept no outside funding or advertisements.

### [Որ մրգերն ու հատապտուղներն են աղիքային վարակների փոխանցման ամենաբարձր ռիսկը ներկայացնում][66]

Աղիքային վարակների փոխանցման տեսանկյունից ոչ բոլոր մրգերն ու հատապտուղներն են հավասարապես վտանգավոր:
Առավել ռիսկային են համարվում այն տեսակները, որոնք ունեն անհարթ, ծակոտկեն կամ թավշյա մակերես (որտեղ
հեշտությամբ թաքնվում են մանրէները), աճում են հողին շատ մոտ, կամ որոնց կեղևը չի հեռացվում ուտելուց

### [Որ մրգերն ու հատապտուղներն են աղիքային վարակների փոխանցման ամենաբարձր ռիսկը ներկայացնում][66]

Աղիքային վարակների փոխանցման տեսանկյունից ոչ բոլոր մրգերն ու հատապտուղներն են հավասարապես վտանգավոր:
Առավել ռիսկային են համարվում այն տեսակները, որոնք ունեն անհարթ, ծակոտկեն կամ թավշյա մակերես (որտեղ
հեշտությամբ թաքնվում են մանրէները), աճում են հողին շատ մոտ, կամ որոնց կեղևը չի հեռացվում ուտելուց

գաղտնիքի, անձնական տվյալների պաշտպանության և պացիենտների իրավունքների ապահովման կարևոր հարցեր։

# Նորություններ

[Բոլոր նորությունները][65]

### [Որ մրգերն ու հատապտուղներն են աղիքային վարակների փոխանցման ամենաբարձր ռիսկը ներկայացնում][66]

Աղիքային վարակների փոխանցման տեսանկյունից ոչ բոլոր մրգերն ու հատապտուղներն են հավասարապես վտանգավոր:
Առավել ռիսկային են համարվում այն տեսակները, որոնք ունեն անհարթ, ծակոտկեն կամ թավշյա մակերես (որտեղ
հեշտությամբ թաքնվում են մանրէները), աճում են հողին շատ մոտ, կամ որոնց կեղևը չի հեռացվում ուտելուց
առաջ:

24/07/2026

### [Բժշկական գաղտնիքը թվային դարաշրջանում. հարցազրույց][67]

Թվային առողջապահության զարգացումը նոր հնարավորությունների հետ մեկտեղ առաջ է բերում նաև բժշկական
գաղտնիքի, անձնական տվյալների պաշտպանության և պացիենտների իրավունքների ապահովման կարևոր հարցեր։

23/07/2026

### [Ուղեղի առողջություն․ գլոբալ բեռից մինչև կանխարգելման հնարավորություն][68]

Հուլիսի 22-ին աշխարհը նշում է Գլխուղեղի համաշխարհային օրը, որը Նյարդաբանության համաշխարհային
ֆեդերացիայի նախաձեռնությամբ կոչված է համախմբելու միջազգային հանրության ջանքերը՝ ուղեղի առողջության
պահպանման շուրջ։

22/07/2026
